content:
Marie: Quick heads-up — planning to flip the `per-tenant-routing-v2` flag during tonight's quiet window (23:00 UTC). Need an owner for the flip and one for smoke/metrics. Safe default should remain enabled for at least 10m after flip. Ping @Ash and @Sam for ops.

Ash: I can own the flip. I'll be on-call then. I'll coordinate the rollout and do the toggle. Can someone confirm the exact safe_default behavior?

Sam: I can run smoke and quick perf checks. My checklist: check 5 tenants (eu-1, us-east, us-west, apac-1, test-1), confirm p50/p95 latency, error-rate spike <0.5%, and KV cache hit rate.

Lucy: For the safe_default: it's `safe_default=true` which routes to legacy path if the new path errors out. Recommend holding that for 10m and then flip to `safe_default=false` after validation.

Ash: Good. Plan: at T=23:00 UTC I will PATCH flag to `enabled=true, safe_default=true`. At T+10m if metrics are green we set `safe_default=false`. If anything abnormal -> revert `enabled=false`. Jordan, can you hold the kill-switch and monitor SLO dashboard?

Jordan: I got the kill-switch. I'll be watching SLOs and error budgets. If I see >0.5% absolute error increase or >20% latency regression at p95, I hit rollback.

deploy-bot: Scheduled flag change: `per-tenant-routing-v2` by Ash at 2026-03-18T23:00:00Z. ID: deploy-2915302468.

Sam: Smoke checklist (quick commands):
```
# health checks against sample tenant
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $API" https://api.redwood.internal/v1/tenants/eu-1/route-test
# check metrics in datadog: query by tag `flag:per-tenant-routing-v2`
```
I'll post the five run results in this thread.

Lucy: Small preflight: make sure the feature flag rollout list excludes large customers (we have an exclusion list under config store key `flags/per-tenant-routing-v2/exclude`). Confirmed it's already set for tonight.

Ash: Copy. I'll wait for Sam's green before changing `safe_default`. Jordan — what's your preferred rollback command?

Jordan: Use our internal feature API:
```
curl -X POST https://ops.redwood.internal/flags/per-tenant-routing-v2/revert -d '{"reason":"auto-rollback","by":"jordan"}'
```
That hits the kill-switch and reverts across all envs. I'll run it manually if needed.

ops-bot: Rollback playbook: https://docs.internal.redwood/playbooks/flag-rollback. Error thresholds: >0.5% error increase or >20% p95 degradation triggers immediate rollback.

Marie: Thanks all. Quick timing recap: 22:50 UTC preflight (Ash + Sam quick smoke), 23:00 flip (`enabled=true, safe_default=true`) by Ash, 23:10 review, if green then `safe_default=false`. Jordan holds rollback. Postmortem notes: if we see customer impact, capture traces and add to the flag's audit entry.

Ash: I'll post live status here during the flip.

Sam: I'll paste smoke outputs. Ready. :thumbsup:

Jordan: Local monitoring is set. I'll call rollback if thresholds hit.

Marie: Great — thanks everyone. See you in-thread at 22:50 for preflight.
